title: interesting
body:
At first I thought that watering the plants went wayyy too fast and that it wasn't challenging at all, but it gradually became more difficult to save enough water to upgrade a plant. NICE!

I also like that you can earn different types of currencies even though the most important one is still the sunshine. There are also a lot of tasks to finish (daily, weekly etc.) and so many things to collect, fe. profile picture icon, white noises and music and of course plants!!

As expected there are a few ads in between, but they are a lot less than before the game update (before thre were ads every time you finished a timed session, even during pomodoro)

Sometimes my tablet laggs or freezes during focus mode, but that doesn't happen often and it can be easily fixed by exiting and opening the app again.

Overall, the developers did quite a good job at creating a game to motivate people to study (at least me...

title: Annoying
body:
Posted: 24-03-2020

Every few weeks, (just like clockwork) parts of the app stop working and the only way to be able to continue, is by spending real money - for once, we can actually use the focus time for gaining raindrops but no free options for anything else. With every problem that has occurred, I have contacted support and it’s become obvious... it’s something they do when we don’t spend money on the app. I stopped playing the apps by this developers, for very similar reasons - nothing is ever fixed, nothing is returned and nothing is compensated for it. The only reason I continue playing this game is because we’ll apparently be able to add friends. Because some of my friends play, it’s the only reason I stay. Besides that, this app causes more stress than anything and it stops me from being able to concentrate and/or focus. So, I don’t use this app for any health benefits - taking away my concentration and making it so I can’t focus on anything else, usually means I’m going to take it out on others (usually through violence)... Hence the reason I don’t use this app for focusing.

—————————
Updated Post: 26-01-2020
Device: iPhone X
Title: Getting Worse?
Rating: 1 Stars

The app isn’t working properly - raindrops and sunshine can no longer be obtained through (no existent) rewards or focusing. All focus and offline raindrops disappear during collection. The ads freeze the screen and you lose EVERYTHING. Showing a screenshot after the app has reopened, WON’T do anything. The developers want screenshots but it shows no problem. Example: $76,000 prior, $76,000 afterwards. Also, the stats are currently only showing a total of minutes.

—————————
Posted: 12-01-2020
Device: iPhone X
Title: Suspect...
Rating: 2 Stars

The game started out great, it was fine and I was actually enjoying it. But today (4 days after installing/playing the app for the very first time), it stopped working properly or I’ve found more errors - after 1.5 hours of focus, the app decided that it needed to restart and used a false advertisement for the notification. It said that I logged in from another device (no one would want to have tried, especially if they know me) and would also have to redo the 2.5 hours, to receive the reward. Even after doing so and watching the advertisement (that’ll apparently give up to 300% extra but had never given it to me), I only received credit for 2.5 hours and NEVER received the extra after being forced to watch 2 videos. The developers are making money from each advertisement we watch, but what are we getting out of it? I DON’T GIVE MY TIME FOR FREE (EVER), ESPECIALLY AFTER CONSTANTLY BEING USED BY OTHERS, TO MAKE THEM MONEY. 

As for the OTHER PROBLEMS: This app has become a major disappointment... the times are wrong. Watching videos to get 36 hours of extra credit, is a LIE! Usually, the time would go forwards but with this app, it removes 4 hours. EG. Have 6 hours, then watch a video to add another 2-4 hours and then notice how the time says 2 hours remaining - obviously it would be 8-10 hours but NOT with this app. As for credits, they don’t seem to match. If I have $1000 and (while focusing) obtained another $2000, it should equal $3000. But this app shows the credit as being $2148. I’m wondering what logic the developers use, as common sense was obviously thrown out the window when it comes to the basics. AND the LAST PROBLEM is raindrops - If I obtain 2000 raindrops, I expect it!!! But to give me 2 raindrops instead, is just plain old scamming!

Português: Cria um programa que de para conectar no PC também, já que estudo pelo computador, tenho que olhar o celular só para ver o tempo, se tivesse como espelhar o tempo no pc pelo menos, ia ajudar muito. Tirando isso o aplicativo é ótimo 👏

 English: Create a program that can be connected to the PC as well, since I study on the computer, I have to look at my cell phone just to see the time, if I could at least mirror the time on the PC, it would help a lot. Apart from that, the app is great 👏

title: Perfeito/Perfect
body:
It has two ways of focusing, one with a break time and one without a break, it’s really nice. Before I downloaded this app, I didn’t used to study that much, but after I did I study even more to be able to water and grow my plants. And it also has an option to join a group and take care of a farm together. I just wanted to know when I’ll be able to unlock the level above 7 of my plants.

Tem dois jeitos de focar, um com pausa e um sem pausa, o que achei bem legal. Antes eu não estudava antes, agora com esse aplicativo, passei a estudar mais para regar as minhas plantas. E ainda tem como você participar em um grupo e cuidar de uma fazenda. Eu só queria saber quando eu vou poder regar minhas plantas acima do nível 7.

title: Quer deixar você viciado no app, não focar!
body:
Por mais que seja um app fofo, eu baixei com objetivo de ficar longe do celular e mais concentrada. Mas na verdade o app é um joguinho cheio de regras, detalhes pra prender atenção e sugestões do tipo “assista o vídeo e ganhe recompensas” como qualquer outro jogo de smartphone. Para mim o objetivo deles é deixar você preso no jogo e longe de outros apps, e não sair do celular de fato. 
O toque da contagem regressiva é um super gatilho de ansiedade, péssimo! Novamente: o objetivo é viciar você no joguinho, e não sair do celular.

title: Finally I can get my studies done!
body:
This app is so beautifully made, full of details and charming elements that keep you studying endlessly! Tracking your statistics, evolving plants and Gardners and even the handbook that resembles a “pokedex” are just perfect touches!
I couldn’t be more impressed by a pomodoro app! I wish I had discovered it sooner!
author: L3mon.drop

title: Used to be great, when did they add ads?
body:
Used to use this app all the time. Decided to use it again to study for finals but every time I go to a new screen or finish a session it gives me an ad even when I opt out of double rewards? I used it for an hour and it managed to give me 6 ads. 

Very distracting when I’m just trying to use the app to collect cute plants and focus. I hate that I login with the intention of using the app, need to claim a daily award AND close an ad AND get an event pop up. It is very distracting when I just want to log on and use the actual focus feature.  

Next time, please remember who your app is for and what we’re using it for. We want to go offline, not be bombarded by check-in events, login challenges, and everything else. Too many features (WHAT are the gardeners for) it goes against the point of the app entirely.

title: Great for ADHD
body:
I’ve had this app for the past three years, I find in the beginning, yes there is a lot of time spent planting the plants but the more you use the focus timer on you’re phone in the long term with this, the less time you spend on you’re phone. Personally I found it helps me to check in and do things in the actual game in the morning of every day, sometimes the evening as well but most of the time just the morning. I always do the max 3 hours every time so to not be distracted as often.

But the pomodor timers come in super handy for school assignments, to make sure to take those micro breaks in order to stay focused well. When not in school I use this in my daily life to keep myself from wasting my life on my phone. It is handy that they have the notifications, they also have it where you can toggle the sound/vibrations as well. 

After a year of using this I found it useful for myself to purchase the yearly subscription, as this app keeps me from downloading wasteful games and pouring tons of money into them and never getting anything done in my real life. 

Super happy with this app, I’d say now I only really spend a bit of time on it in the morning and before I turn my phone off for the night before reading and getting ready for bed. I end up saving my brain from never being on my phone anymore maybe an hour everyday now vs 13+ hours and never having a good sleep schedule and also saving money from not wasting it on pointless games. 

Eventually since I’m almost done unlocking the plants fully I can see myself not needing the annual fee anymore but I’ll definitely keep using it for the timers and to help newbies out in the group I’m in. 

There also in the works of adding a sleeping timer feature and I’m really looking forward to that. 

Thank you for making such a helpful tool app! It’s been great to improve my quality of life with this tool that’s for sure.

title: Not great for ADHD.
body:
I'm interested in "gamified" focus apps because I have severe ADHD. Unfortunately, this app may be good for neurotypicals, but it's not ADHD-friendly. It's constantly buzzing my phone with notifications, demanding my attention and distracting me. It contains a ridiculous number of video ads, though you can get a paid subscription to skip them. Finally, the core concept is flawed, because I was able to plant more than 20 plants with only one short focus session. I spent way more time planting virtual plants than actually focusing. This is effectively a "reverse Pomodoro"... 20 min of focus and 40 min of game. Not ideal when you have ADHD, and get easily distracted.

TL;DR: a gamified focus app that's more game than focus.

title: Erfüllt seinen Zweck, aber viel zu viel drum herum
body:
Der Timer ist genau das, was man sich wünscht, wenn man fürs Lernen eine kleine Belohnung sucht. Die verschiedenen Timer-Optionen sind gut durchdacht und passen zu unterschiedlichen Lernphasen.

Das Problem liegt im Drumherum:
1. Zwar muss man nicht jede Werbung ansehen, aber ständig wird man dazu verleitet, zusätzliche Belohnungen durch Werbeclips freizuschalten.
2. Es tauchen zu viele Pop-ups auf, die auf Nebenfunktionen hinweisen. Das lenkt eher ab, als dass es beim Lernen hilft.
3. Der Fokus liegt spürbar stärker auf dem Ausbau des Gartens als auf dem eigentlichen Lernprozess.
4. Die deutsche Übersetzung ist schwach – auf Englisch wirkt die App deutlich runder.

Insgesamt eine gute Idee und ein nützliches Werkzeug, solange man den ganzen zusätzlichen Kram ignorieren kann.

title: Focus !?
body:
Also zunächst muss man sagen, hat die App getan was sie sollte und ich bin fokussiert bei den Dingen, die ich erledigen möchte.

Warum dann 3Sterne?
Zu den Focus ,,Sessions‘‘ gibt es ein Spiel, bei welchem man quasi Punkte bekommt und somit dann Pflanzen sammelt und das Spiel ist mit allem was dazu gehört leider nur mäßig gelungen.
1.)im Prinzip wird man von der App konstant dazu eingeladen , mehr Zeit am Handy zu verbringen, sei es durch Werbung die man guckt/gucken soll oder anderes 
2.)das Spiel wirkt an mehreren Stellen nicht durchdacht und Features /Belohnungen sind unlogisch verteilt
3.)mit einer App soll Geld verdient werden keine Frage, selbstverständlich gibt es dann mehrere Optionen Geld zu zahlen
Schade ist, dass das nicht nur Abkürzungen sind sondern bestimmte Elemente im Spiel nur so erhalten werden können und die Preise dafür lachhaft hoch sind .

Zum Thema Integrität und das rundet für mich das ganze ab: man kann sich entscheiden monatlich Geld zu zahlen, womit man dann auch in Focus Sessions Zugriff auf Apps erhält. So ziemlich das Gegenteil von dem wofür die App an sich steht. Ich würde , wenn ich nochmal eine neue Focus App downloade eine andere nehmen.

title: Fun but really buggy
body: I like the app and have been using it while I study. They’ve made some great improvements to the user experience like introducing the Pause button which can be very helpful in case you do need your phone but don’t want to quit the focus session. Lately I feel like the app hasn’t been working well anymore though. Sometimes you cannot watch an ad even though you want to and it says to reopen the app but that doesn’t work. Then all of the sudden, an ad is available to watch. Recently I’ve noticed that sometimes I cannot claim the reward I got for watching an app because I cannot click on the X to go back to the app. It’s really frustrating. Besides the apps, the focus session fails automatically sometimes when you close your phone or when the battery warning pops up but you don’t notice until much later. So while I do enjoy the game aspect of collecting raindrops to grow plants, the user experience is really improbable and frustrating at times

title: Lächerlich abgeguckt und dann schlecht umgesetzt!
body: Die App Focus Plant ist extrem von dem Vorreiter in dieser Art von Apps, nämlich Forest, abgeguckt und dann viel zu spielerisch umgesetzt. Das intro gleicht einem dieser „Strategiespiele“ in dem man die ersten 10 Minuten mit einem Tutorial beschäftigt ist, in dem man nur auf vorgegebene Dinge tippen muss. Der Versuch die App Forest, welche deutlich vor dieser released wurde, hat zufälliger weise genau das selbe Logo, nur mit einem verspielteren Design. Dazu ist in der App unübersichtlich. Ich finde es zwar nicht schlimm, wenn App-Entwickler sich an anderen Apps inspirieren lassen aber das gleicht den Methoden von Voodoo. Das einzige Argument sich diese App herunterzuladen ist, dass sie kostenlos ist. Aber selbst wenn Forest doppelt soviel kosten würde (Forest kostet 2,29€) würde ich sie Focus Plant vorziehen.

body:

Me costo encontrar un grupo para ingresar, encontré un grupo que a mi me gustaba y subí aún más de notas y tiempo en focus. 
Solo que sugeriría a la App que me dejaran buscar nombres de grupos, mi amiga abrió un grupo y no puedo ingresar porque no lo puedo buscar por su nombre.

Muy recomendable, le pongo ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ porque cumplió con mi objetivo (subir de notas y quitar mi vaguez) solo que añadiría lo del buscador que he comentado

title: Me gusta mucho
body:
Me encanta la app, la gamificación aplicada a una app de estudio que te ayuda a mantenerte concentrada y focalizarte en las tareas que estás haciendo. Además, los desiertos colaborativos te motivan a crear vínculos con amigos/as.

Ahora que han añadido la Guardería mejoraría algun aspecto. Reduciría el número de gotas necesarias (es excesivo), y permitiría poder ir dándole gotas poco a poco (como cuando riegas una planta en tu jardín), para así poder ir regando poco a poco y ayudar a tus amigos/as a regar las plantas de sus guarderías.

¡Por lo demás me encanta! ¡Muchas gracias por diseñar esta app!

title: Problema con el idioma.
body:
¡Buenas!
Llevo más de un año con esta aplicación y nunca me cansa, personalmente para mí es la mejor. 

Utilizo esta app en español, pero hay un problema con la traducción. Hay frases que no están bien expresadas. Por ejemplo la sección de guardería, cuando le das a más información, la última frase dice: "Invitar a amigos a la enfermera las plantas juntas". Dificulta el entendimiento de la frase. 

Agradecería que mejorasen la calidad de idiomas (si quieren les puedo ayudar, soy nativa española).

title: Propositions d’amélioration
body:
Bonjour, j'utilise l’application depuis plus d’un an déjà et j’aime beaucoup ! 
J’ai quelques propositions afin d’améliorer l’application : 
- Quand on aide des amis, ce serait bien de gagner quelque chose en retour (coffres, soleils, gouttes…). Cela inciterait les amis à aider et on y gagnerait à aider. La plupart du temps j’aide quand je peux, mais les autres n’ont pas le reflex de venir m’aider. Je suis toujours la seule à contribuer. 
- Ensuite, ce serait bien de mettre un modèle qu’un joueur proposerait pour planter des arbres. La plupart du temps, on veut faire un joli dessins dans le groupe, mais comme on manque de coordination, on a tendance à faire des trucs moches. S’il y’a un système de votes pour le meilleur « dessin », on pourrait coordonner ça directement. Ça serait plus joli. 
- Enfin, je réalise que beaucoup ont presque terminé de planter tous les arbres, avec le niveau maximum. Peut-être faudrait-il en créer de nouveaux, avec d’autres mondes ? En effet, je trouverais cela très chiant de devoir augmenter tout au niveau 8… Ça serait trop répétitif.

title: Does the opposite of what you want from it
body: The core idea of earning a currency from focus time to spend on upgrades is a good one. HOWEVER, there is so much stuff in this app that has nothing to do with focus time, and activiely encourages you to engage with the app INSTEAD of focussing. Like loot boxes, upgrading stuff, bonuses that you achieve simply from time passing (outside of focus time), endless menus with exclamation marks showing bonuses to claim. It is designed like any other mobile game, encouraging constant engagement with the game part of the app itself, and the focus timer is almost a secondary feature. You could play this game by simply having it open and waiting without ever hitting play on the pomodoro time, thanks to the stupid whale that gives you currency just for having the app open. If you want an app to help you focus, do not get this app.

title: Really cute and helpful app but...
body:
I’ve been using Focus Plant for about a year now and it’s really good. I definitely recommend this for people who can’t concentrate, get distracted, etc...
 I do have a few tweaks to make it a bit more friendlier and easier.

1. On groups, you can’t search for a specific group name and even though there are invites, I think some people may want to find the name of a group to be in because they want to have that extra connection to it.
2. So, when you want to friend someone, make a group, use a certain method, you need to do some tasks before getting it (planting more plants). Although this is motivating, it takes kinda long to be honest. I think it should be much simpler. Like you could reduce the amount of plants?
3. I think there should be a to-do list so that we can, with the tags, link them up and make it more organised and fun to study or whatever people are trying to focus on.
4. I think the screen/home space should be less cluttered. I press everywhere and 90% of the screen is just buttons. Maybe the four tabs on the top could be combined?

Anyway, I really enjoy this app and I hope other people will too. It’s really effective and really cute ☺️ 

- Hayhay

title: Feature Request: Prevent Double-Counting of Simultaneous Sessions Across Devices
body:
Hi Forest Team,

I love using Forest to help me stay focused, and I currently use it on both my iPhone and iPad. However, I’ve noticed that if I start a focus session on both devices at the same time, the total focus time gets doubled in my account. For example, if I focus for 2 hours using both devices simultaneously, Forest logs it as 4 hours.

I understand this happens because the app adds up all focus sessions across devices. But it would be really helpful if Forest could detect overlapping sessions and either:
	1.	Only count the session once (based on the start time), or
	2.	Provide an option to disable syncing between devices so I can keep focus time separate on each one.

This would help ensure that the statistics and focus time remain accurate. I really appreciate your hard work and hope this feature can be considered in a future update!

Thanks for building such a great app.

Warm regards,
Dr. Valleesh Bhat

title: Good app!
body:
The concept is, collect raindrops by not using your phone (further referred to as ‘focus’) and to grow plants by using those raindrops. You also get sunshines which you can use to buy other game related stuff including raindrops. 

I use the app to make sure I read or study and the whole concept of collecting raindrops to grow more plants really helps! 
I find it annoying when I don’t have enough raindrops to be able to grow a plant so I focus more by picking up a novel, drawing, studying or meditating. It blocks all the other apps (kinda. Rather, if you are focusing and you try to use other apps without the whitelist feature on, your progress so far will be canceled and you won’t get the raindrops for the time you did focus) and there are pause buttons in case you want to use another app or take a break. 
Plus, I can see my progress through all the plants I grew and the daily challenges make me wanna focus more to get extra raindrops.

title: Utile e divertente, ma addio batteria
body: L’app fa il suo lavoro e anche bene: aiuta effettivamente a stare concentrati e a non usare il telefono per il lasso di tempo prestabilito. Il lato più ludico dell’applicazione è ben fatto, molto divertente e stimolante. Grossa, grossissima pecca: scarica la batteria con una velocità disarmante. Nel mio caso particolare in un’ora di utilizzo con schermo bloccato la batteria scende del 12%, mentre con schermo sbloccato ma rivolto in basso (come l’app consiglia di fare perché basti sollevarlo per vedere quanto manca) scende del 15%. Insomma, se si vuole studiare per qualche ora di seguito utilizzando l’app, bisogna avere presa e caricabatterie, questo è l’unico aspetto che mi trattiene dal votare 5 stelle.

title: I highly advice you to download this app!
body:
Very nice app, it helps me focus, but I have a point that might could be done better:

it feels a lot like a game (with all the interactive stuff), and I quickly find myself spending MORE time on my phone because of focus plant instead of less. I think this could be solved with an extra option: max time on the app. This could be something like the weekly streak. How this could work: you can set a maximum amount of time you want to spend having the app opened. This wouldn’t count the time you spent focusing of course. Then, if you spend less time then that you could get rewards working similarly to the weekly streak. And maybe a pop-up when you are almost at that time (maybe 5 minutes before?). 
Of course, this is just an idea and I don’t know if this is possible, but it would be a great addition! Some small points:

I would love to see all the available frames in the collectibles, because it’s a bit confusing to have no idea how many there are and how to get them
Could there maybe be added some garden decorations which you can unlock very easily? This way new players can also get some decorations instead of having to complete a whole handbook first.
Again, these are just some ideas and there might be reasons you guys didn’t add this. Obviously I don’t want to only “hate” on this amazing app! My screentime has gone down super far since I’m using this. Some of my favorite features are:

the rainy whale. It’s very nice to earn a little bit of raindrops even when you aren’t focusing
The visitors! I love how they just randomly show up and give you stuff, and better, that you can even chose who shows up! Truly a great addition!
Rooms and groups: what’s better than focusing alone? Focusing with friends of course! There’s a big difference so you can explore both! The deserts (in the groups) are great as well!
The different ways to focus: I like that there’s not only a countdown timer, but also a stopwatch and a pomodoro timer! It helps me stay away from the screen better and I use all of them!
Overall, great app! I highly advise people who want to use their phone less to download this app!

title: Ironically cluttered for a focus app
body:
The app is undeniably well created, from its function to the cute graphics. However, I find it ironic that this is a focus app, and yet just like the mobile games that want to garner too much attention from the users, this app is quite cluttered with its reward systems. If you follow the Pomodoro technique, it's as if the app wants you to spend your short breaktime engaging with it. Clicking all the cluttered rewards and holding the buttons to raise your plants.

I just think it could be simplified.

title: A suggestion!
body:
The app is actually really interesting and motivational. I always had a hard time studying now I can study for multiple hours a day. 

However, I also like to study at night so one of my issues that can be kind of annoying is that when I start a focus session say at 11:00pm and end it at 12:02am, the 1+h is counted for when I ended the session instead of when I started it. Sometimes I may not reach my daily goal during the day so I want to do it at night but it doesn’t always get accounted for for that day unless I end the session before 12:00am. So it would be great if the amount of time focused could get cut off at 11:59pm and just continue as the first minutes of the next day at 12:00am if that makes sense?

But again this app is so cute and I think it’s very smart and I really recommend it!! But that’s just my suggestion!

author: aplayerwithaissue

title: Great app but needs some improvements
body:
Overall, this is a good app that motivates me to focus to get raindrops to plant and water plants . The plants are very cute as well. 

Suggestion 1. It would be great to include a function so friends can chat to each other on the app. This will be great for groups so that members can remind each other to farm and for leader and officers to discuss some things. Also it can help for nursery if someone needs help with a task.

 Suggestion 2. Can you include a way to enable friends to focus together? Like they come together to focus together to motivate each other. Also make it so that when focusing together, everyone can get more raindrops in the focus session. 

 Suggestion 3. I do not think that the forest focus passport is a good idea as it benefits others who pay, and is not an impression-“pay to win”-that you want to give as this is a productivity app. Maybe you can give the forest focus passport buyers less advantages and lower the price at the same time.

 Suggestion 4. It would be good if the Shikudo apps are connected to each other in a way. For example instead of waiting to do task in pocket plants, maybe players can use the plants they collected in focus plant instead. Like the starting plant can be a plant they collected, which merges into another plant that they collected. And to keep playing, they would have to collect more plants in focus plant. This will keep the plant merge special to each player. 

 I hope you can use my suggestions in another update. However, your app is still good without it, but it can be improved. I hope this review was helpful to you and thank you for taking your time to read this! Have a nice day/night. 

 ~a fan of the game

body:
i love the whole game idea, but i think it’s somewhat more a game than a studying/productivity app. you have groups you can enter, raindrops you can use to grow plants, etc.

if you really need motivation to study and can’t get yourself to accomplish your goals, i recommend this app as you can use the raindrops earned from taking a phone break to grow your very own plants, letting you be more motivated :)) 

if you have trouble with both of the above mentioned (motivation and getting easily distracted) i recommend you move on to another app which is less game-like while still having the key focus of the app (keep users off the phone), for example forest or flora.

title: My 10yo & I love this app!
body:
My son and I have ADHD and find it difficult to stay focus. Using this we are both able to do our chores and tasks while bonding and having fun. 

This is an amazing app that makes me WANT to do chores and work. There’s so many things to do, rewards, challenges and groups that I haven’t gotten bored!

As a self-led entrepreneur, it can be challenging to stay on task and lose motivation. This app is allows me to work towards something when what I’m working on doesn’t have immediate gains which really messes with my dopamine. 

I become hyperfocused on collecting raindrops than the actual work I’m doing, which I used to avoid entirely or hyperfocus on for hours. 

Now, I use the Pomodoro in 15 mins. Intervals and I’ve got more done in 2 hrs. than I have in a day! 

My son likes cleaning now and he’s able to keep a steady pace using this app. 

Also, my save files is shared between my phone, iPad and iMac seamlessly! 

Thank you for this!
Seriously, I’ve been struggling before finding this. I hope there’s continued support with this app as it’s been a lifesaver!

xoxo

title: Not too useful
body: I didn’t find this app motivating. Too much game play that seems kinda irrelevant to helping me focus. “Points” (raindrops) come mainly from meeting random and even irrelevant challenges rather than from actual time spent focusing, which is rather discouraging if their challenges don’t align with your goals or intents. I find there are too many things to keep track of too. I like simplicity. Anything more than that seems a waste of time. I love the website StudyTogether, but can only track one thing on there, so I went looking for something similar that would help me to track something else, but haven’t found anything, so I tried this, but this is just too cluttered with a bunch of things to keep track of which felt like a waste of time. There also doesn’t seem to be a way to turn off the haptics. Each time you water a plant it shakes your phone about three times. This is a waste of battery life and feels annoying too. I also don’t need a whitelist since I rarely use my phone for anything other than calls and if a call comes in, I must take it and don’t want to lose track of how much time I spent on my task, not to mention that feels punitive. I also would just end the session since I can’t talk and work on my task also. So, I just end up doing 5 minutes at a time so I don’t get penalized, but that is disruptive of flow. I don’t need a babysitter. I needed an app that encourages me to spend more time on my task and tracks it accurately. Growing plants seemed fun, but looking at the plants didn’t give me a feel for how much I’d focused, which would have been encouraging. The two felt out of sync. If you are looking for something similar to what I was, then this may not be the app for you.

title: Questionable.
body:
This app is somewhat effective, I suppose. However, exiting out of the app cancels the timer, and it wants to you to not turn your phone off at all, claiming that flipping your phone over saves more battery than turning it off. It still gives you rewards if you quit halfway through, which seems counterproductive to me.
On strict mode, it doesn’t allow you to go into apps; which is fine, accept that it completely restricts your ability to go into apps at all. You also have to use suns in order to put apps on a whitelist.
When I told it not to send me notifications, it responded with “Are you sure you don’t need a little reminder to stay off?” Which just makes me personally very uncomfortable.
It’s a fine app in regards to focusing, I suppose. However, certain things (like the ones I mentioned) make me feel as if there’s more going on in the background, and most definitely does not make me feel like my phone is safe. It seems like they’re trying to mine your data.
It could be just me, but it could also very much be more. The whole thing is suspicious, in my opinion.

title: Thank you so much for this game!!
body:

Also, THANK YOU for not making this app so ad heavy like other apps can be! The only way you need to watch ads is if you want bonus rewards which is a pretty good incentive because I always want extra rewards to grow my plants and buy more things from the store 🙂

I really can’t wait until the developers make a multiplayer mode for focusing on tasks, I think that’d be pretty cool! 

One thing I think would be cool to add, is if you can actually see the gardeners around the plants! I find myself pretty disconnected from the gardeners so adding this feature would make it much more enjoyable and realistic? 🙂

Lastly, if there could be more options for land bgm and white noise such as coffee shop jazz or people talking in the background, etc., that’d be awesome! Instead of me having to go on my laptop to play some bg noise, this would be convenient!

Other than that, great job developers! Keep up the good work!

title: 2-in-1 !
body:
This app is literally SO amazing! Let’s start with how it actually helps you stay away from your phone and focus. My phone is almost always on a focus session, and my screen time overall has shown a decrease. 

Another thing that makes the app stand out is how it’s an adorable game as well! I love to play it a lot, and it’s not addicting (I try my best to avoid addicting games)! Planting and taking care of all of your super cute plants is just an awesome experience. I really enjoy expanding my gardens, opening chests to reveal more gardeners, and getting to join a group. The app in general is just so cute and you can get two things at once: a great game and less screen time. 

One thing I would really like, though, would probably be a chat feature in the groups. It would be really fun to get to chat to the other members in the group, and we could feel closer to each other and help out.

But other than that, this app is TOTALLY worth trying out! I will definitely recommend it to my friends! I’ve already told my dad about it and he loved the idea. Thank you so much! 💕

This app also allows you to play with others and plant a garden together. Once you focus for a certain amount of time the game gives you water to plant and grow flowers and other plants. You can discover new plants that the game designers made up, which are fun and creative. This game is not just for younger kids it's for any age group and is appropriate for girls and guys.
          As much as I love this there is one thing that I wish they had done. I love other apps I've seen that plant trees when you grow a certain amount of plants in the game. I wish that they did that for this app. Other than that I am in love with this game.

title: Very cute
body:
Pros:
The graphics, sound effects, and interactions are very cute. It’s a great concept and it does help extend my time on task. 

Issues:
There are a lot of 30 second ads that you have to watch. This includes achievements that require watching ads which I think is counter to the purpose of the app (reducing screen time). 
I totally get that they need to make money and I’m fine with paying for apps. That said, $5 a month to get rid of the ads is a little high for the value it offers. I’ll give it another week but if the ads get too annoying then I’ll probably just delete it.

title: Helpful Recommendation. Please read!
body:
I really love this app already and I've only been using it for two days. It really helps, though I have a couple things that'll make it even better and help me more.

1: Add a pause button for the timer.
Sure the whole point is to STAY focused, but what if we have to get up to do something? The water we get won't count. Life happens, especially during coronatime.

2: Add a stop watch(?) option instead of just a timer.
If you exceed your focus time, what if you forget to check your phone but you're still working? You would have done all that extra work just for it not to count at all.

PLEASE CONSIDER THIS BECAUSE WE PROCRASTINATORS NEED IT

title: Fun & Motivational
body:

Rainy the Whale is such a cutie, he follows you wherever you go! Plus, you can control your BGM settings and gain other fabulous prizes in chests by using sunshine, the in-game currency. Having a goal for the game like "I want to max level that land's plants today" helps motivate you to set your phone on focus mode. Definitely a great app, and I've already recommended it to my friends!

A student who was desperately falling behind ✊😩
author: MikazukiNika

title: Cute game, not good for focusing
body: You can basically play through the game with the raindrops that the game gives you— the chests and the whale award you with way too many raindrops, so many so to the point that you basically never have to focus to get raindrops, because there’s always an abundance of them, effectively nullifying the entire point of it as a focusing app. My suggestions would be to maybe have an option for people to deactivate the whale if they want to? Because for me, I definitely don’t want the whale. I go to do something— like eat dinner— and I come back and the whale has basically done all the work for me, again, defeating the purpose of the entire game as a focusing app. Another thing is the wait times. Why do the plants nap? You should be trying to waste all of your raindrops on your plants at one time so that you can actually focus to get more— the napping gets in the way of spending your raindrops, again, defeating the purpose. Maybe the player should be able to deactivate that as well?

author: CristalPJ

title: Adorable game and an effective app
body:
I very much love this game. It’s so adorable and it excites me to know what other species of each realm I have unlocked. I personally love this game a lot because it revolves around gardening; I garden myself and I try to learn more about it. The game itself is self-explanatory for the most part. The game itself is manageable without any in-app purchases in my opinion. I have no particular issue with app thus far. I can’t wait for the upcoming updates for this app although. I’m not sure if the 3rd stage evolution of the plants is a secret that must be figured out or if it just hasn’t been patched in yet. I’d like to get insight on that to be honest. Overall, great app that has adorable characters/plants/atmosphere.

In regards to its effectiveness as a focus app, I’d say it does a great job. I honestly have a phone addiction and I’d spend hours on my phone watching YouTube/Netflix, scrolling through social media, and so on. Even with the app limits that Apple implemented, I still find myself bargaining with myself to add more time to these apps. I consciously know that I’m doing it, yet I can’t get myself out of that habit quite yet. The basic function of the app which is focusing for durations of time to earn more water to grow and to plant new plants has helped me reducing my screen time and focus on my coursework for college. I’m so grateful to have come across this app and the developers who created it.
